assets.status: Working/review asset; author selection open
assets.qualification: Alanine orientation, improper torsion and coordinate illustrations. F10 reproduces the 438,986-structure population and modes; it does not assign absolute stereochemistry, equilibrium or stability.
assets.title: Alanine improper-torsion distribution
assets.description: The N–Cα–C(carboxyl)–Cβ improper-torsion histogram for 438,986 alanine-reference coordinate blocks has two modes at ±124.2°, describing the orientation of substituents around the central carbon.
assets.note: The coordinate distribution does not assign absolute stereochemistry, equilibrium populations, or thermodynamic stability. Independent reconstruction reproduces the population and modes of the historical alanine histogram.

assets.qualification: Energetic evolution through heating, the high-temperature interval and cooling. F09 is source-bound, but the historical displayed-axis transformation remains unresolved; do not compare it numerically with reconstructed raw totals.
assets.title: Potential-energy distribution during heating and cooling
assets.description: A two-dimensional density plot of 366,067 temperature–potential-energy observations shows separate heating and cooling branches, a dense high-temperature population, and a lower final low-temperature energy region.
assets.note: Raw source totals are distinct from the unresolved transformed axis in the historical manuscript image. Energy alone does not identify a reaction or product. This figure was reconstructed independently from retained LAMMPS thermodynamic records; “raw” identifies untransformed energy totals, not a logarithmic vertical axis.
